identity_evidence: Kengo Kuma and Associates identifies Yu no Eki Ohyu as a completed 2018 Akita project of 1,026 square metres and one floor.
The architect describes it as a community center combining a shop, cafe, open-air theater, park, footbath and biotope beneath one large roof.

Kazuno City identifies the same facility as Michi-no-Eki Oyu at Towada Oyu Aza Nakayachi 19, with roadside-station parking, charging, 24-hour toilets, market, cafe and footbath. The attached open-air theater is one secondary space and does not make the whole facility a theatre.
